propositions: Cloud description and comment bodies encoded as plain-text ADF paragraphs must become structured ADF through bidirectional Markdown-aware codec functions (markdown_to_adf, adf_to_markdown, fit_markdown_to_adf_limit)

Data Center safe Markdown bodies must render as native Jira wiki markup through a segmenting renderer (wiki_render.py) with fallback when pandoc is absent, without monotonic length decay over repeated passes

Bidirectional sync must suppress echo loops and unchanged updates via baseline tracking, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way comparison while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) through origin gating
Concurrent local and remote edits must be detected and flagged as conflicts rather than silently overwritten, with baseline/local/remote comparison using last-write-wins semantics
Comment synchronization must use append-only ID mapping to mirror only newly created comments bidirectionally without sync or delete operations
Idempotent round-trip conversion must reach documented thresholds: Cloud Markdown↔ADF 99.75% idempotence, DC 92.7% of bodies rendering rich with zero monotonic decay over five passes
